name: Spider hand icon
description: UI slot icon for the spider hand: three arms fanned off one knuckle, caught mid-reach. Composes ss.lib.spider-arm three times rather than drawing a leg three times, so the slot, the two finds and the evolution all show the same limb. The rim is `$arcane.dark`, a deep violet. It was `$cobalt`, the arms' `$steel` with the grey taken out, and that made the Four-Leaf Clover that wears this rim a third blue on the passive bar. Its nearest rim is the Wing blade's `$arcane` at ΔE 16.4 — the same hue a step darker, which the `distinct` rule's 13 clears, where the brighter violet tried for Widow's Grip sat 8.5.

evolved.description: Widow's Grip. The rim goes gold the way every evolved slot in the roster does, but the three limbs are swapped out for ss.lib.spider-arm-widow — banded, spurred, hooked on three toes, bruised purple carrying blood — rather than recoloured, because the evolution changes what the arm is and not just what colour it is. Same fan, same knuckle, same three angles, so the two slots read as one weapon at two ages.
